text.text_excerpt: I hadn't been to Harrahs buffet in 3yrs & it was just ok then. Now its been upgraded and improved! I went on Friday night which is the seafood night. They had all you can eat crab legs, crawfish, Char-Grilled, fried & raw oysters, fried & boiled shrimp, catfish, fried clams, stuffed clams Damn near anything under the Sea. The they had other selection of meats Roast beef, ham & Pork they would slice at your will. They also had a Asian selection of pork egg rolls, fried rice egg drop soup & more. The dessert area was massive also alon with the soft serve ice-cream machine. The staff was very friendly and attentive. The service was similar to being on a cruise which is awesome in my book. I'm not a buffet person but this sounded like fun so I went with a friend whose family also lives out of state for the Thanksgiving buffet. It was amazing! There was a long line to get in and we had to wait about 15 minutes but the line moved surprisingly quickly and it was well worth the wait. When we arrived at our table someone came and took our drink order in under 2 minutes which is impressive because this place was insanely busy. While the food selection was pretty diverse, I know that I was, like most of the people, most excited about the unlimited crab legs. How could you not be? They also had a nice selection of veggies, beef, chicken, and seafood dishes that I enjoyed sampling. ...

A friend recommended this buffet to me so I decided to give it a try. The Buffet served a wide array of dishes including oysters, crab legs, shrimp, crawfish, and southern fare, all of which were actually quite delicious and worth my money. I didn't bother getting any of the Asian or everyday food as they were among the many things in the buffet that did not look very appealing. Staff was very attentive and I enjoyed getting the fruit juices when asked what I wanted to drink. There were a lot of desserts available and some of them I found were pretty good.
